homeTitle: Spot the pattern. Find the set.
homeSubtitle: Look across three attributes, find groups of three, and clear each round.
singlePlayerDescription: Practice at your own pace across three rounds.
multiplayerDescription: Create a room or join friends with a room code.
multiplayerNotReady: Online rooms are not connected yet. This feature will be added in a later version.
howToStepOneBody: Every card has a shape, a shape color, and a background color.
howToStepTwoTitle: Find a set of three cards
howToStepTwoBody: For each attribute, the three cards must show either all the same value or three different values.
howToStepThreeTitle: Find every set, then call “No sets left!”
howToStepThreeBody: Score for each correct set, lose points for wrong picks, and earn a bonus for clearing the board.
howToScoring: Correct set {reward} · wrong set {penalty} · board cleared {bonus} · score never drops below zero
ruleExampleTitle: The rule applies separately to every attribute
ruleExampleBody: A valid trio can have the same shape, three different colors, and three different backgrounds. All three attributes must independently follow the rule.
footerNote: A fresh, independent implementation of a classic three-attribute matching challenge.
boardInstruction: Call “Find a set!” before choosing three cards.
feedbackWrong: That is not a set. {delta} points.
mixedAttributePattern: {attribute} has two alike and one different
feedbackDuplicate: That set was already found. Your score has not changed.
feedbackSelectFirst: Select “Find a set!” before choosing cards.
roundCompleteBody: You found every set on this board.
confirmQuit: Leave this game and return home? Your current session will end.
masteryLocalNote: Progress is saved in this browser only and is not synced across devices.
unrankedNote: No verified sets this session — find at least one set to build mastery.
feedbackCorrectXp: Great set! Level {level} · {delta} points · +{xp} Mastery XP
xpSavedNote: Saved. This XP is yours even if you leave now.
rulesGoalBody: The deck has {deck} unique cards: 3 shapes × 3 shape colors × 3 background colors. Each board deals {board} distinct cards. Find every valid set on the board.
rulesSetBody: A set is exactly 3 distinct cards. For each attribute — shape, shape color, and background — the three values must be all identical or all different. Every attribute is checked independently.
rulesSetExampleValid: A valid set: same shape, three different shape colors, three different backgrounds.
rulesNotSetBody: If even one attribute splits 2+1 — two cards share a value and the third differs — the triple is not a set. All three attributes must follow the rule at the same time.
rulesSetExampleInvalid: Not a set: two cards share a shape and the third has a different one (2+1 on shape).
rulesTurnBody: Call “Find a set!”, then select three cards. Read the result, then repeat. When you believe no valid sets remain, call “No sets left!” to verify and clear the board.
rulesRevealBody: The number of undiscovered sets is hidden. Once per board you may reveal the exact count for {cost} point. A wrong “No sets left!” claim also costs its penalty and reveals the count for the rest of that board.
rulesScoringNoSetsWrong: Wrong “No sets left!” claim: {delta} points (and the count is revealed)
rulesScoringNoSetsRight: Correct “No sets left!” claim: {delta} points (clears the board)
rulesScoringFloor: Your match score never drops below zero.
rulesMasteryBody: Mastery XP is separate from match score and cannot be lost. Level 1/2/3 sets award {xp1}/{xp2}/{xp3} XP, and clearing a board awards +{clear} XP. XP is saved when each board is completed, so progress from a cleared board is kept even if you leave mid-session.
rulesPrivacyBody: Mastery progress is stored locally in this browser on this device only. It is not an online account, is never uploaded, and is not synced between devices or browsers.
settingsSavedNote: Changes apply immediately and are saved automatically on this device.
settingsAccessibilityNote: Accessibility and appearance settings never change scoring, XP, or ranking.
settingsDataLocalNote: Settings and mastery progress are stored locally in this browser only.
settingsStorageOk: Local storage is working. Your progress is being saved on this device.
settingsStorageUnavailable: Local storage is unavailable. Progress cannot be saved in this browser session.
settingsResetConfirmBody: This permanently erases your mastery XP, rank, and stats on this device. Your settings are kept. This cannot be undone.
saveFailed: Could not save your progress to this browser. Your game still works, but progress may be lost when you leave.
metaDescription: An English-first combination card game with English and Korean language support.
